kind: Five-CLI terminal-tool feasibility audit; Pi real isolated prototype
paidAuthorization: Owner ongoing multi-CLI prototype authorization; bounded Pi aihubmix deepseek-v4.1-flash low and attempted Claude haiku

pi.implementation: Native extension exposes loom_reply wrapper, calls actual MCP using ctx.executeTool, preserves real result, returns terminate only for successful final published receipt. No abort/kill/fake ACK. Each batch terminates only if every completed tool opts in.
pi.sessionMode: one original session file resumed by two CLI processes, one fresh authorized cold-stdio bridge per Run

freeTests.beforeImplementation: Same successful real Kernel publication plus nonterminal wrapper produced 2 requests; expected 1 failed.
freeTests.terminalBatch: 2 rounds, 2 actual local fake-provider requests, complete real Kernel writes
freeTests.mixedToolBatch: 2 rounds, 4 local fake-provider requests; nonterminal sibling prevents premature termination
freeTests.setupFailures: Initial missing extension file and nested-tool wiring errors retained privately; zero paid requests.

unverified: actual Claude hook invocation against real Worker MCP
one generation per successful final publication

codex.verdict: No public successful terminal-tool mechanism found in this audit. PostToolUse continue:false modifies tool feedback and continues; turn/interrupt ends as interrupted, not accepted as equivalent.

kimi.verdict: Internal stopTurn exists with normal result/usage persistence, but MCP adapter does not forward it; external PostToolUse is asynchronous. No supported configuration entry found.

opencode.verdict: No generic MCP/tool.execute.after terminal flag found. Native json_schema StructuredOutput has a normal loop-exit branch; separate output-submission candidate, not Loom receipt integration.

freePrototype.kind: deterministic local fake-provider transport proof; not paid or Loom acceptance
freePrototype.harnessLimitation: Trailing GET /session/:id/message returned 400 because paging query was omitted. Saved POST responses and post-exit SQLite independently verify both rounds; no retry/model calls were used to recover evidence.
limitations: Provider outputs and usage numbers are deterministic fixture values, not real model behavior or billed tokens.
StructuredOutput is OpenCode built-in final output, not Loom MCP tool. No Room, Worker service, receipt, ACK or execution fences tested.
Normal loop termination retains finish=tool-calls plus structured output and time.completed. Do not infer errors or native completion from finish alone.
No restart-and-resume validation. Same running server/session continued twice.
Only successful schema-valid calls tested; rejected submission, unknown writes and parallel tool batch not tested.

decision: Retain Kernel/Worker authority; prototype per-CLI terminal adapters. Do not replace explicit Room actions with inferred stdout or claim universal efficiency from Pi.
